title: Settings
resetConfirm: Reset all settings to their default values? Nothing is stored until you click Save.
saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.

general.machineTranslation: This translation was made automatically and has not yet been reviewed by a native speaker.
general.formatsHelp: Default format for new documents. ODF needs the conversion program (desktop app); Save As always lets you pick another format.
general.recoveryHelp: How often a recovery copy of changed documents is made (1 to 60 minutes), to recover after an unexpected shutdown.
general.converterBrowser: You choose the conversion program (LibreOffice) in the desktop app. In the browser only the native formats work.
general.converterMissing: No conversion program found. Choose soffice from LibreOffice to open and save ODF and older formats.

appearance.ribbonCompact: Compact ribbon: icons only on small buttons
appearance.ribbonCollapsed: Ribbon collapsed by default (tabs only; Ctrl+F1 toggles)

status.weergave: Text: view buttons (print layout, reading mode)
status.rekenblad: Spreadsheet: sum, average and count of the selection
status.database: Database: status of the working copy

profilesHelp.standaard: Ctrl+1 = Heading 1, Ctrl+2 = Heading 2, and so on.
profilesHelp.word: Ctrl+1 = single line spacing, Ctrl+Alt+1 = Heading 1.

editing.miniToolbar: Show the mini toolbar when selecting text

spellingOptions.controleren: Check spelling as you type (red wavy line)
spellingOptions.autocorrectie: AutoCorrect: TWo INitial CApitals, capitalise the first letter of sentences and common typos

editing.spellingHelp: Dictionaries: OpenTaal (Dutch) and SCOWL (English, UK and US). Right-click an underlined word for suggestions; F7 opens the Spelling and Grammar pane.

external.account: Follow the setting of each account
external.nooit: Never load automatically (you can still allow them per message)

about.description: Text, spreadsheet, presentation, database and email in one local workspace from the OpenAEC Foundation. Your files stay on your computer.
about.translations: Dutch is the source language. The other languages are machine translations by OpenAEC and are still being reviewed; improvements are welcome.
